name: Must use GitHub for any new projects. Existing projects should have migration plans developed asap.
requirementTitle: Must use GitHub for any new projects. Existing projects should have migration plans developed asap.
requirementDescription:
Any projects using something other than GitHub 
should have migration plans in place and new projects can only use GitHub for source code repository and development platform
why: Enables security measures to be designed once and re-used many times, otherwise all teams and projects are required to duplicate effort, and any errors introduce security risk.
